thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (EU region) — threshold breach 09:04 UTC. Sampled responses show chat-like outputs instead of embedding vectors.

oncall-alex: ack. paging in. i'm grabbing logs.

sre-maya: any customer-impact estimate?

prod-support-erin: CS flagged 3 enterprise customers reporting noisy outputs; one paused jobs. sending list to thread.

oncall-alex: quick triage: tailing proxy logs shows routing -> model_alias 'embed-lite@v3' is resolving to runtime variant 'chat-instruct-v2' in eu-west-1. that explains text responses.

eng-runtime-lead: who applied the alias update? i see a commit in routing-config 2min before onset by ops-ryan.

ops-ryan: that was an automated anchor-swap deploy from Canary rollout — i triggered the alias promotion script. didn't expect type change.

prod-support-erin: customers impacted: corp-a (ml pipeline), corp-b (search embeddings), corp-c (analytics). corp-a paused jobs, corp-b saw failures and retries spiking.

sre-maya: severity S2 given multiple paying customers and retries. mitigation priority: stop the misrouting, roll back alias, mitigate customer retries.

oncall-alex: immediate mitigations i propose: 1) add transient routing policy to deny chat-instruct variants for embedding routes in EU; 2) rollback alias to previous pinned revision; 3) rate-limit retries at edge for affected customers. i'll coordinate.

eng-runtime-lead: how confident are we that alias rollback won't flip other traffic? need safe command.

ops-ryan: runbook recommends `redwood route get alias embed-lite@v3 --history` then `redwood route promote alias embed-lite@v3 --revision <prev>` — i'll prepare the specific prev revision id.

oncall-alex: run the deny-by-type first so we stop producing bad outputs. can someone push a policy patch?

eng-runtime-lead: pushing temporary policy now. snippet:```json
{
  "policy_name": "deny_chat_for_embed_routes_eu",
  "match": { "route_type": "embedding", "region": "eu-west-1" },
  "action": "deny",
  "deny_conditions": { "variant_interface": "chat" }
}
```

eng-runtime-lead: policy applied via control-plane API. confirmed 200.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Policy deny_chat_for_embed_routes_eu applied by eng-runtime-lead at 09:07:42 UTC.

ops-ryan: rolling back alias now to rev-2021f3 (pre-swap). executing promote...

ops-ryan: promote completed. route mapping shows embed-lite@v3 -> embed-engine-v1 now.

oncall-alex: monitoring logs and response bodies. sampling 50 requests — embeddings restored for 46/50, 4 still hitting chat variant from cache/edge.

sre-maya: those 4 might be cached prefix or a stale regional cache. invalidate caches for the alias across CDN and edge.

ops-ryan: invalidation command run: `cdn purge alias:embed-lite@v3 --regions eu-west-1` shows async job id 0x9f3.

prod-support-erin: contacting affected customers: corp-a on hold, corp-b sees reduced failures, corp-c wants postmortem. i'm drafting notification now.

customer-success-john: please include action items we took and ETA for full remediation. also ask customers to re-run a small sample to confirm.

oncall-alex: root cause (initial): anchor promotion tool promoted a variant anchor whose runtime_interface != alias's intended interface (chat vs embed). there's no guard in promotion to check interface compatibility.

eng-runtime-lead: agreed — promotion pipeline should validate interface contract (embed vs gen/chat). adding task to runtime team: add pre-promotion compatibility check + unit test.

ops-ryan: logging the CI job id that triggered: ci/anchor-promote #4827. adding rollback tag.

sre-maya: customer impact summary: a small % of embedding requests returned chat-style payloads (non-vector) between 09:04 - 09:08 UTC in eu-west-1. retried clients produced spikes in 5xx and increased costs due to unexpected token generation.

prod-support-erin: mitigation completed: policy deny applied at 09:07:42, alias rollback at 09:08:30, cache purge started 09:08:45.

oncall-alex: mitigation verification: from 09:09 -> 09:15 sample shows embedding vector responses 100% for new requests.

eng-runtime-lead: follow-ups: 1) block auto-promote for anchors that change interface until contract checks land; 2) add monotonic canary that asserts schema on sampled responses for 5 min after promotion; 3) add alert for "route returns wrong interface" (schema mismatch).

ops-ryan: i'll open a changelist for anchor-promote to add interface guard and safety flag.

customer-success-john: i'll send a templated message to affected customers with remediation steps and offer a post-incident call.

prod-support-erin: timeline so far: 09:04 Pager triggered -> 09:05 ack -> 09:07 deny policy -> 09:08 alias rollback -> 09:09 cache purge -> 09:15 verified mitigations.

sre-maya: assigning owners: eng-runtime for code fix (eng-runtime-lead), ops for deploy/runbook update (ops-ryan), SRE to add schema alert (sre-maya), CS for customer comms (customer-success-john, prod-support-erin).

oncall-alex: oncall clear? i'll keep watch for 1 hour and then handoff to eng runtime for follow-ups.

eng-runtime-lead: will take follow-ups. thanks.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved (S2 mitigated). Please file postmortem in incidents/ and link to this thread.

ops-ryan: filing postmortem draft now, will include commit ids, CI job, and exact routing map diffs.

customer-success-john: sending initial customer note now.

prod-support-erin: marking affected customers and next steps in support tracker.

oncall-alex: handing off to eng-runtime-lead at 10:10 UTC for post-incident ownership.

eng-runtime-lead: received. I'll schedule a follow-up retro and prioritize interface-check task next sprint. :eyes:
